<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0" datamodel="null" initial="s">
  <state id="s">
    <transition event="go" cond="x > 1" target="f"/>
    <onentry><send event="e" delayexpr="late"/></onentry>
  </state>
  <final id="f"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: `cond` on `<transition>` is not an `In('stateID')` predicate, the only condition the null data model supports

secondary.message: the null data model is selected here

notes: the null data model has no data, value expressions, location expressions, or scripts; conditions may only be `In('stateID')`, with the state ID quoted
diagnostics.help: rewrite the condition as `In('stateID')`, or select a data model that supports it, such as `datamodel="ecmascript"`

diagnostics.message: the null data model defines no value-expression language, but `<send>` uses `delayexpr`
